shots.title: Cold open
shots.video: Pure black. Faint heat shimmer; a single red ember glows in the center of frame. Sound of the first riff chord.
shots.lights: All dark. SEM_FOCAL at 10% deep red, slow breathe.
shots.sync: Picture starts at 0 ms with the audio's first sample.

shots.title: Headlights
shots.video: Low angle on a black muscle car's grille at dusk on a desert highway. Each guitar chord stab snaps the headlights on, then they fade.
shots.lights: White stab on SEM_OUTLINE + SEM_FOCAL on every 'Onsets (guitar)' mark, 300 ms decay.
shots.sync: Cut lands on Bar 1. Flash frames = guitar onsets.

shots.title: Loading up
shots.video: Close-ups cut on the chord stabs: boots on asphalt, a guitar case slammed into the trunk, a hand turning the ignition key.
shots.lights: SEM_ARCHES_LTR sweep left→right on each chord; red/white.

shots.title: Launch
shots.video: The drums kick in: rear wheels spin, smoke, the car launches out of frame; tail-light streaks.
shots.lights: Drums enter → full-yard red chase. SEM_MINITREES flash on snare (beats 2 & 4).
shots.sync: Cut exactly on the drum entry (Bar 5). Impact 2 = launch.

shots.title: The road
shots.video: Drone top-down over an empty two-lane desert highway at golden hour, center dashes passing in time with the beat.
shots.lights: SEM_PATH / SEM_ARCHES_LTR run white 'road dashes' one step per beat.

shots.title: Driver POV
shots.video: Driver's-eye view over a dusty dashboard, warm amber sun low on the horizon, a dice charm swinging from the mirror.
shots.lights: Verse bed: warm amber/orange, low intensity. Vocal onsets twinkle on the matrix/SEM_FOCAL.
shots.sync: Verse starts on Bar 9. Impact 3 (00:22:09) = the mirror charm swings hard.

shots.title: Signs
shots.video: Roadside signs whip past one per bar: a bent speed-limit sign, a 'NO EXIT' sign, a sun-bleached billboard. Each passes on the downbeat.
shots.lights: Each downbeat pops a different group (SIDE_LEFT → SIDE_CENTER → SIDE_RIGHT → HOUSE), amber with a red edge.

shots.title: The gang
shots.video: Silhouettes of friends in the back of a pickup alongside, fists up, hair blowing, dust kicking up behind.
shots.lights: Ping-pong SEM_SIDE_LEFT / SEM_SIDE_RIGHT on beats 2 & 4.

shots.title: Build
shots.video: Speedometer needle climbing, heat haze rising, the sky shifting from amber to deep red.
shots.lights: Brightness ramp 30%→80% across 3 bars; color shifts amber → red.
shots.sync: Impact 6 (00:47:09) = needle slam; hard cut at Bar 24.

shots.title: The sign
shots.video: A giant neon highway sign reading HIGHWAY TO HELL ignites letter by letter as the car blasts past camera.
shots.lights: CHORUS LOOK: full yard red + white on every beat; megatree spiral; matrix title card 'HIGHWAY TO HELL'.

shots.title: Fire lane
shots.video: Lines of flame erupt along both road shoulders, chasing the car down the highway.
shots.lights: Fire effect on SEM_ARCHES + SEM_OUTLINE; drum onsets strobe SEM_FLOODS.

shots.title: Whip
shots.video: Whip-pan off the car to black.
shots.lights: White full-yard hit then drop to 20%.

shots.title: Roadhouse
shots.video: Night. A neon-lit roadhouse and gas station; bikes parked out front; purple and blue haze.
shots.lights: Verse 2 bed: deep purple/blue; red only on snare hits.

shots.title: Inside
shots.video: Jukebox, pinball lights, dice tumbling across felt, a deck of cards fanned out. Each object lands on a downbeat.
shots.lights: Matrix/SEM_FOCAL pinball sparkles on 'Onsets (guitar)'; bed stays cool.

shots.title: Night drive
shots.video: Back on the road under a full moon; telephone poles strobing past one per beat.
shots.lights: Chase across the sweep order, one step per beat (poles = beats).

shots.title: Something behind
shots.video: The rearview mirror fills with a red glow; the car accelerates; the horizon ahead starts to burn red.
shots.lights: Red rises band by band: SEM_BAND_GROUND → MID → ROOF; final bar snare-roll ramp to white.
shots.sync: Impact 9 (01:32:28) = mirror glance. Hard cut at Bar 50.

shots.title: The reveal
shots.video: The car crests a hill: below, the actual house light display blazes in the dark. This is the biggest drum surge in the song.
shots.lights: CHORUS LOOK at 100%: full yard, megatree, matrix. Shockwave from SEM_FOCAL outward on the downbeat.

shots.title: Real footage
shots.video: Intercut the real filmed light show (wide shot of the house), cut on every downbeat with flame-road shots.
shots.lights: Same chorus look as Chorus 1, brighter.

shots.title: Into the pixel
shots.video: Camera pushes into a single glowing bulb until it fills the frame.
shots.lights: Everything fades except SEM_FOCAL.
shots.sync: Transition to the solo on Bar 59.

shots.title: Lightning
shots.video: Lightning storm over the desert; a guitarist silhouetted on the car roof; every bolt lands on a guitar note.
shots.lights: Guitar-solo lightning (trigger cookbook): white strikes on 'Onsets (guitar)'; everything else dark blue.

shots.title: Sparks
shots.video: Sparks spray off a guitar neck and off wheels grinding the road; fast macro cuts.
shots.lights: High-rate electric blue/white shimmer on SEM_ALL.

shots.title: Fretboard
shots.video: Macro shots: fingers on strings, intercut with macro shots of the real pixels; speed ramps.
shots.lights: Fast sweeps changing direction every bar.

shots.title: Rise
shots.video: Camera rises straight up off the road into the night sky.
shots.lights: Vertical wipe upward on all props.

shots.title: Flame tunnel
shots.video: The car drives into a tunnel of fire.
shots.lights: Full chorus look; fire on the arches.

shots.title: Peak
shots.video: Neighbours and crowd outside the real house, hands up, phones out; real footage of the display at full blast. The song's energy peak.
shots.lights: PEAK: everything at max brightness; megatree + matrix + all groups.

shots.title: Ping-pong
shots.video: Alternate drone shots of the house and the highway, one cut per downbeat.
shots.lights: SIDE_LEFT/SIDE_RIGHT ping-pong per bar.

shots.title: Cut out
shots.video: Speed blur builds to white, then hard cut to black.
shots.lights: Crescendo into the drop.
shots.sync: Builds toward Impact 14; the last frame is white.

shots.title: Stopped
shots.video: The car sits stopped on the empty road, engine ticking, a single red glow on the horizon. Each guitar chord produces one flash of red light.
shots.lights: Everything cuts to near-black on the first frame. Then sparse: only SEM_FOCAL + one prop per guitar chord, long decays; matrix pulses on vocal onsets.
shots.sync: Impact 14 (02:59:18) = drums drop out. The blackout must be frame-exact.

shots.title: The beacon
shots.video: The house display glows on the horizon; each chord stab makes the flash bigger.
shots.lights: Each chord adds one more group (it builds up).
shots.sync: Impact 15 (03:08:00) = the driver looks up. This bar grid is approximate (no drums, so the tempo drifts); sync the flashes to 'Onsets (guitar)'.

shots.title: Fill
shots.video: The car fires up again, drum fill.
shots.lights: Snare-roll strobe ramp.

shots.title: Flythrough
shots.video: The camera flies down the highway, through the megatree, into the house display; the full band hits.
shots.lights: Everything red/white at full yard; final chorus look.

shots.title: Held chord
shots.video: The final chord holds; the flames rise.
shots.lights: Hold at 100%, slow color swirl.

shots.title: Final crash
shots.video: A hard white flash, then black. The title HIGHWAY TO HELL burns in fire on black and then fades.
shots.lights: White flash on the final crash, matrix title, then blackout.
shots.sync: Impact 16 (03:26:21) = final crash. Fade to black by the end of the audio.
